answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the vine of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the velvet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The atlas of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
